                release_date = release_date_part

            'title': song_title,

            'release_date': release_date
        })

lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0][2:]
        artist = parts[1]
        release_date = None
        if 'RELEASED_AT' in line:
            release_date_part = line.split('RELEASED_AT ')[1].split()[0]
            if release_date_part != 'TODO':
                release_date = release_date_part
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artist': artist,
            'release_date': release_date
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs with release dates")

    if not line or line.startswith('#'):

    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:

        song_title = parts[0][2:]
        artist = parts[1]
